subject: POC commissioning cadence & close plan — org invite, API keys, IP allowlist, VPC peering
messages:
From: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@beaconhealth.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@beaconhealth.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC commissioning cadence and close plan

Thanks Jonas — quick note from our infra side to make sure we're aligned before you draft the MAP.

Overview: Beacon is ready to run a 3-week POC focused on throughput and latency for our clinical summarization workload. Primary constraints: we must validate data egress controls and a VPC peering model (no public endpoints for inference).

Network details (attached):
- CIDRs we can peer from: 10.10.0.0/16, 10.20.0.0/16
- Egress allowed for control plane: 35.197.20.0/24 (example) over TLS 443

Org owner: I'll create an initial admin invite for "jonas@beaconhealth.ai" and add Tom. Expect that invite by EOD.

Questions for Redwood:
1) Do you require a pre-generated API key or should we wait until the org is onboarded?
2) Preferred maintenance window for VPC peering? We prefer weekends but can do a weekday evening.

Attachments: beacon-cidrs.txt (CIDR list)

—Sarah Miller
Head of Platform, Beacon Health AI

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@beaconhealth.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC commissioning cadence and close plan — org invite, API keys, IP allowlist, VPC peering

Thanks Sarah — great, that's exactly the level of detail we need. Draft MAP and milestone plan below (high level) and attached is a working MAP workbook (Beacon-MAP-v0.3.xlsx).

High-level milestones (suggested):
- Day 0 (Org & Access): Beacon creates Redwood org admin invite — Redwood sends org provisioning link and initial role checklist (we do not issue API keys before org exists).
- Day 1 (Network & Peering): Exchange peering details and schedule peering: target window Sat 2026-06-19 02:00–04:00 UTC (weekend).
- Day 2–4 (Smoke & Auth): We provision default service account once org is created; you receive one scoped API key for non-production testing (short TTL).
- Week 1 (Warm-up): Run small test corpus to validate tokenization, KV cache hit rate, and latency baselines.
- Week 2 (Load Ramp & Observability): Gradually increase to target QPS; enable tracing & token cost monitoring in console.
- Week 3 (Acceptance & Close): Biweekly sync, finalize acceptance criteria, sign-off.

Immediate asks from Redwood:
1) Confirm the peering window above or propose a preferred alternative.
2) Confirm org admin email (we saw "jonas@beaconhealth.ai") so we can pre-populate the onboarding flow.
3) Confirm whether Beacon wants a long-lived service integration (we can create a short-lived API key for the POC and exchange a longer-lived service principal later).

Notes on security: when we create the scoped API key it will be limited to your org and set to expire after 14 days by default; we can extend TTL with a signed request. Peering requires a one-time route update on both sides, no public IP exposure for inference VMs.

Attachments: Beacon-MAP-v0.3.xlsx, redwood-network-diagram.png

I'll wait for the org invite and the CIDR confirmation, then Karthik will take the technical lead on the peering and key provisioning.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 08:15:00 -0400
Subject: Internal: POC runbook notes — org, API key flow, network checklist

Jonas/Hannah/Laura — internal kickoff notes and runbook excerpts before we get the invite from Beacon. Keeping short:

Org & API keys:
- On org creation we create a customer org ID and a default "org-admin" role. On that signal we will: 1) create a service-account object, 2) generate a short-lived API key (14-day TTL) scoped to the POC project, 3) store the key in the customer's org vault and send it via our secure transfer link.
- If customer wants an HSM-backed key policy we route to Private deployment team (longer lead).

Network/VPC peering checklist:
- Pre-requirements from customer: CIDR list (received), peering owner contact, NAT config if applicable.
- Redwood requires outbound TLS 443 to control plane IPs for telemetry and usage reporting — we will provide exact egress IP block at least 24 hours before peering.
- Peering test plan: 1) BGP handshake (if needed) or static route add, 2) ICMP + HTTPS check to test endpoints, 3) perf run with 50 concurrent requests at p95 SLA target.

Operational notes:
- We'll provision a test API key prior to peering if they request it, but we prefer to validate peering first to avoid key misuse.
- I've created a short runbook: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C-POC-MAP (internal), and placed a template Map workbook in the shared folder.

I'll join the call with Beacon during the peering window to monitor the handshake.

— Karthik
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@beaconhealth.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@beaconhealth.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 11:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC commissioning cadence & close plan — confirmed windows and next steps

Jonas — thanks for the clear plan. Confirming the following from Beacon: 

1) Org admin invite: I created the admin for jonas@beaconhealth.ai and added Tom. You should see the invite; please send onboarding link to that address.
2) Peering window: Sat 2026-06-19 02:00–04:00 UTC works for us. Please have your infra on standby.
3) API key: We prefer peering-first, short-lived key after peering. That flow matches our security posture.
4) CIDRs: see attached beacon-cidrs.txt (10.10.0.0/16, 10.20.0.0/16).

Acceptance criteria (what we will sign off on for POC):
- Successful peering and ICMP/HTTPS verification between both sides.
- Baseline throughput at 50 QPS with p95 latency < 350ms on our test suite.
- No unapproved public egress observed in the first 72 hours.

I'll upload our short security addendum if needed; otherwise we can proceed. Tom will be our primary on-call during the peering window.

Attachments: beacon-cidrs.txt

Best,
Sarah Miller
Head of Platform, Beacon Health AI
